reviews.reviewbody: Here, among much 'unidentified female voices' and 'machine static' are Sargent Shriver talking about his appointment to be the Poverty Czar, how Kilgore wanted to run for the Democrats, much to the chagrin of Johnson and Bill Moyer, and various other minor things. an okay listen.
